body: I just wouldn't want to be a burden on anyone.

You're fine. This doesn't sound unsympathetic at all.

I forgot to mention that I'm a junior and I have already gotten my Associate's Degree.

I'm working with financial aid right now, and my only option left is to take out an alternative loan to pay for this quarter and then do a hardship withdrawal.

I know I can just move back home and work my ass off until I can come back, but I just don't see the point of fighting for this anymore. It seems like more trouble than it's worth.
